description: This source file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube that extends HTMLPurifier_Filter. It provides functionality to sanitize and embed YouTube videos within HTML content, specifically replacing YouTube object embeds with span tags and then restoring them with proper embed code.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube
classes.description: A filter class for processing YouTube embeds in HTML content, replacing object tags with span placeholders and restoring them with embedded players.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Pre-processes HTML by replacing YouTube object embeds with span placeholders.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Post-processes HTML by replacing span placeholders with actual YouTube embed objects.

methods.name: armorUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes the YouTube video ID URL by replacing double hyphens with a hyphen and an HTML entity.

methods.name: postFilterCallback
methods.description: Callback used during post-filtering to generate the YouTube embed object HTML based on the matched ID.
